[Pending Restart] These changes will go into effect next restart. If you already know Swipe (Bear) or Claw in Wildcard you will gain a new ability roll upon logging in. Note that if you have Cat or Bear Form you will NOT lose Claw or Swipe! It will just no longer require 2 AE.
Learning Cat Form, Serpent Form, or Worgen Form will now automatically teach you Claw. This ensures if you roll a Cat Form you have a spammable ability to use in it.
Learning Bear Form will now automatically teach you Swipe (Bear). This ensures if you roll Bear Form you have a spammable ability to use in it.
Steady Shot can now be learned or rolled at level 1. This will ensure Hunter Archetypes have a spammable ability at level 1.
